Get ready
Words, carried by light.

Write a message and press Play. Record the entire grid on another device, starting before the lights change. Keep all five fixed lights visible.

Choose that recording in Decode. Copy the recovered message, including its original spaces, tabs, and line breaks.

The message repeats. For a better chance of recovery, record two complete passes. Use ordinary video mode, keep the dots sharp, and avoid glare. Short messages are quickest.

Four patterns per second. Nothing is uploaded or saved by this app. Your browser must support the video’s format. Real camera reliability is still being tested.

The display flashes. Stop if flashing light causes discomfort.
